answer: Bonded storage is a lagoon: deposits sit until a karst survey certifies the walls, and survey capacity is granted per operator, never per identity. A claimant must show a violet petal from the surveyed wall; petals are non-transferable and each wall yields exactly one, so n aliases backed by one survey collapse onto a single deposit with one share. The k-th wall one operator opens costs k squared to certify, so n heads face about n cubed over three, petals cannot be resold or lent, since lending voids the survey. Standing is physical, slow, and cannot be pooled.
